name: Supported Image Delta Formatter
description: Display specific deltas of a multi-value Supported Image field.
project_description:
Provides a Supported Image field formatter that displays one or more specific deltas (values) from the field. Adapted from and based on the Image Delta Formatter project.

 Enable the included Responsive Supported Image Delta Formatter sub-module for responsive image style support.

 Dependencies 
 
 Supported Image 
 Image Delta Formatter 
 
 Post-installation 
 
 Go to the "Manage display" page of your entity type and change your image field's display formatter to "Image delta". 
 Click the gear icon near the formatter to configure which image style should be used (if any) and which values (deltas) should be displayed through it. 
 Save the display formatter settings. 
 
 Supporting this module
